reviewed_scope: All existing bundle JSON, JSONL and Markdown outside source/; also includes exact mechanical source excerpts.
source_freeze_metadata: Relative captured_path values; Git commits, blob IDs, SHA256, byte and line counts retained.
historical_source_bytes: Unchanged; this portability check is not permission to rewrite historical sources.
reviewer_locator_convention: d5/source and d5/reviews are historical relative evaluator prefixes, mapped in README; /root agent identifiers are logical collaboration identities, not filesystem locators.
original_capture: Original external source-freeze.json retained unchanged; portable copy is byte-identical because it contains no machine-specific source locators.
